_comment: The live server's conf, copied verbatim by deploy.sh (§35 L4). Only genuine per-environment deltas live here (§35 C1, D1); every absent game key resolves to the Go defaults, documented in full in conf.default.json. startZone stays authored even though it equals the Go default: it names which zone a fresh character spawns in on the LIVE server, and every zone file in api/zones/ loads regardless of it.
